adminOnly: The tenant administrator manages and publishes the organization's websites.
intro: A website is a VitePress template (pages in Markdown). It is built into www/ and published to hosting over SFTP.
select: Select a website or a publishing target from the list.
newIntro: A default VitePress template is created: a home page, an About page and settings in _vitepress/config.mjs. You can edit it here, or ask the assistant.
name: Name (usually the domain, for example mycompany.com)
confirmDelete: Delete the website {{site}} and its built version? It stays on the hosting.
buildHint: Building saves the finished website to {{dir}}; publishing uploads it to the chosen target.
addTargetHint: Add a publishing target in the list.
templateIntro: Pages are .md files (index.md is the home page), images belong in public/, settings and the theme in _vitepress/.
hostKeyPending: The server key is saved on the first connection.
confirmRemoveTarget: Remove the target {{name}}? The files on the server stay.
keepKey: The stored key stays unless you paste a new one.
keepPassword: The stored password stays unless you enter a new one.
sealed: The password and key are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
